lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (1) to right flange (6): a real fold of about 81-88 deg. The line sits on the outer-skin surface; nearest scan point is 0.01-0.13 mm away at t=25/50/75%. On the outer skin, the midpoint of the arc is where the surface normal turns half way between the plate (0 deg) and the outer flange face (about 81 deg). The line is 0.10-0.43 mm from that point at t=10/25/50/75/90%. Using the inner-skin 88 deg bisector (normal at 44 deg) instead puts it 0.67-1.00 mm away, still at or under the 1 mm limit. The line is parallel, spans y -48.6 to 49.3 of the 101 mm fold, and has no reliefs.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Plate (1) to left flange (5): a real fold of about 81-88 deg. The line sits on the outer skin; nearest scan point is 0.05-0.08 mm away in the 25/50/75% sections. It is 0.13-0.24 mm from the outer-skin arc midpoint (normal at about 40 deg). Using the 44 deg normal it is 0.74-1.10 mm away; that is borderline, and only the 75% station goes past 1 mm, under this stricter definition. The line is parallel and covers the full length, y -49.0 to 48.8.
